summary: Flotek Industries filed an 8-K to disclose a third amendment to its existing Revolving Loan and Security Agreement with Amerisource Funding. The amendment extends the loan maturity date to October 31, 2026 and grants the borrowers an option to further extend by 12 months or terminate at maturity. No equity, merger, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine credit-facility amendment. The filing contains no deal terms or shareholder action. There is no premium, recommendation, or structural complexity to analyze. This is a standard debt-refinancing disclosure.
